what: My Qwen job (pid 13896, running since 14:45) left the card on its watchdog: a launcher of 09_testbed_scale (gpu_big.sh, threshold 16424 MiB) fitted on GPU 0 only without it.
impact_on_others: that launcher waited at most about 25 s for my process (two watchdog looks 12 s apart); no failure

what: My LLaVA job (pid 37950) ran out of memory under its OWN cap (14.4 GiB) while loading and exited; restarted later with a 14.8 GiB cap and W_E - W_0 computed on the CPU.
impact_on_others: none found (no out-of-memory message of another agent names this process)

what: My LLaVA job (pid 51485; the two extra conditions LOC and WPROJ) reserved its memory at 15:54:10, one second after the launcher of another verifier (08_rescope/p11_retrofit/verify/run_gpu.sh, waiting for 16200 MiB since 15:52:39) had launched its LLaVA job on the same free card. Their load ran out of memory (their message names process 51485 with 14.26 GiB).
impact_on_others: one failed start of that job; its launcher retried after 120 s, launched at 15:57:46 and the job ended with exit 0 at 15:58:49: a delay of about 3.5 minutes, no output lost
cause: my queue inspector (vcommon.launchers) only knew the launcher scripts that existed when I wrote it (gpu_wait.sh, wait_gpu.sh, gpu_run.sh, gpu_any.sh, gpu_fill.sh, gpu_big.sh, gpu_launch.sh); run_gpu.sh was not among them, so its 90 s wait was invisible to my two looks
fix: 16:02: vcommon.launchers now recognises any shell script whose name contains gpu / wait / launch / queue, in every argument layout in use (unknown layouts count as a LLaVA-sized waiter on both cards), and can_start refuses to start on a card while ANY other agent's launcher is waiting for it

what: I stopped my own LLaVA job (pid 52777, LOC, running since 15:59:28) by hand because I believed two launchers of the reviewer (code/rescope/review/gpu_wait.sh) were waiting behind it. They were not: both had started their jobs on GPU 0 at about 15:54. The condition was run again later.

Deviation from the card convention (Qwen on GPU 0): GPU 0 was held by other agents' jobs and queued launchers from 14:57 on, so the remaining Qwen conditions (the two random cells, protection keys, batch-8 Rel: pid 46703; the z* repeat test: pid 56782; cap 9.2 GiB) ran on GPU 1, under the same start rule and watchdog.
